title: SonarQube Analysis tokens (sqa_, sqp_): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: SQA_ vs the lower-case sqa_ and prefix: sqp- in place of the sqp_ separator. Twin of "SonarQube Analysis tokens (sqa_, sqp_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of sonarqube-analysis-token-bearer-header: prefix: SQA_ vs the lower-case sqa_. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
